title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0128e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.000984
  m_eff = 2.3601e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2686e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.2228 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0099 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.044541 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = 1.508e+0
  J_spin = 4.307e-2
